formulas.K1_0: lim_{q->infinity} sum_{j>=0} (-1)^j*(2*j+1)*u_j(q)/(1-nu); u solves the spectral Schur system specified in ANSWER.md
formulas.V1_short_coeff: (2/sqrt(pi))*lim_{q->infinity} q*(pi*u_0(q)-pi*(1-nu_u)); u solves the spectral Schur system specified in ANSWER.md
formulas.spectral_definitions: q=sqrt(s), m=sqrt(k^2+q^2), d=2*(nu_u-nu)/(1-nu), Phi_j=pi*(2*j+1)*J_(2*j+1)(k)/k, Psi_j=pi*J_(2*j)(k), D_ij=pi*(2*i+1)*delta_ij/2
formulas.spectral_u: (A-B*C^(-1)*B^T)*u=(1-nu_u)*(pi/2)*e_0; use infinite-basis limit before q->infinity; at d=0 use A=D without hydraulic block
